conversion_rules.message: Cash is invested per the strategy and, while held, is subject to the Program Fee. Cash can instead be kept in a non-program account to avoid the fee.

source_doc.section: Treatment of Cash Balances in your Account

conversion_rules.message: With a Style Manager or PAS Manager strategy, contributed assets are generally sold to invest per the manager’s strategy. The client bears the tax, or can direct in writing that the position be moved to a brokerage account instead.

conversion_rules.message: Mutual fund shares in a share class that isn’t eligible for the program are exchanged into the eligible class (or sold). Front-end loads already paid and any deferred sales charge remain the client’s cost.

conversion_rules.message: A Custom Managed Strategy can hold program-approved mutual funds and ETFs, with its cash allocation in cash alternatives such as money market funds. Assumes this fund is on the approved list.

montgomery.notes: Longtime self-directed brokerage relationship, not yet enrolled in any investment advisory program. Holds a large legacy COST position (multi-decade holding, minimal cost basis), a municipal bond, and a small diversified ETF sleeve. Actively discussing IAP enrollment using the Tax Efficient Transition Service to manage the tax impact of diversifying the COST position over multiple years rather than all at once. The brokerage account also holds two blue-chip stocks, a Class A mutual fund carrying a sales load, and a money market fund, so the conversion map shows how each kind of holding is treated under each program strategy type.
